study: Colonization item-production recovery: binary-only versus references-assisted
launcher: No independent sub-agent execution tool exposed; no codex/claude/opencode executable found. Plugin discovery found no usable launch capability.
primary_goal: Recover direct input/output dependencies for manufactured items from original executable consumers and tables; classify special cases and boundary conditions.
arm_A: Fresh worker; no target-specific guides, previous reports, annotations or pre-built analysis DB.
arm_B: Same target/toolchain/task; guides and prior RE reports allowed and logged. Freeze hypotheses before code verification.
primary_metric: Elapsed time to verifier acceptance of same required code-backed scope, including source retrieval/read/notes time for B.
prebuilt_metric: Report verification-only time separately and charge packet preparation once; do not confuse with primary end-to-end metric.
expected_claims_location: Reviewer-only, not supplied to either worker at kickoff.
fixed_scope: Both arms same DOS target; Windows only as a later held-out portability trial.
not_blind: Coordinator already exposed to prior investigations; coordinator findings are assisted setup, not Arm A.
